entries.en: The bus reached Albi just as my phone ran out of battery.
entries.zh: 公共汽车到达阿尔比时，我的手机刚好没电了。

entries.en: Thornbury tipped the sand out of his shoes before coming into the kitchen.
entries.zh: 索恩伯里进厨房前，先倒掉了鞋里的沙子。

entries.en: Stonebridge reused the envelope, carefully covering the old address with a blank label.
entries.zh: 斯通布里奇重新使用了那个信封，仔细地用一张空白标签盖住旧地址。

entries.en: Smallwood recognized her mother's handwriting before she unfolded the letter.
entries.zh: 斯莫尔伍德还没展开信，就认出了母亲的笔迹。

entries.en: Sanjay shook the box gently, trying to guess what was inside.
entries.zh: 桑杰轻轻晃了晃盒子，想猜出里面是什么。

entries.en: Oddie could repair the clock, but nobody could find the missing key.
entries.zh: 奥迪能修好那座钟，但谁也找不到丢失的钥匙。

entries.en: Cooley carried the smaller suitcase so that I could keep both hands free.
entries.zh: 库利提着较小的那个行李箱，好让我腾出双手。

entries.en: Breckenridge saved the last sheet of wrapping paper for the awkwardly shaped parcel.
entries.zh: 布雷肯里奇把最后一张包装纸留给了那个形状不规则的包裹。

entries.en: Baer had forgotten to bring the candles, so we ate by the light of a desk lamp.
entries.zh: 贝尔忘了带蜡烛，所以我们借着台灯的光吃了饭。

entries.en: He agreed to talk about his experience with listeriosis, but not on camera.
entries.zh: 他同意谈谈自己患李司忒氏菌病的经历，但不愿面对镜头。

entries.en: I couldn't finish the Decameron before the library asked for it back.
entries.zh: 图书馆要求归还《十日谈》时，我还没读完。

entries.en: The translator refused to anglicize the family's surname merely to make it easier to pronounce.
entries.zh: 译者拒绝仅仅为了让这个姓氏更容易读，就把这家人的姓氏英语化。

entries.en: Zhivago held the door open while the children carried their model ship outside.
entries.zh: 孩子们把模型船搬到外面时，日瓦戈扶着门，不让它关上。

entries.en: Wilhelmina found a dried flower between the pages of her old recipe book.
entries.zh: 威廉敏娜在旧食谱的书页间发现了一朵干花。

entries.en: Summerson took off his glasses to examine the scratch on the lens.
entries.zh: 萨默森摘下眼镜，查看镜片上的划痕。

entries.en: Salam lowered the music when the baby finally fell asleep.
entries.zh: 宝宝终于睡着后，萨拉姆把音乐调小了。

entries.en: The two specialists disagreed about the extent of sacralization visible on the scan.
entries.zh: 两位专家对扫描图像上可见的骶骨化程度看法不同。

entries.en: A battered suitcase stood alone on the quai after the last passengers had gone.
entries.zh: 最后一批旅客离去后，码头上孤零零地放着一只破旧的行李箱。

entries.en: The oliphant in the painting had a broken strap and a silver mouthpiece.
entries.zh: 画中的象牙猎号有一条断了的背带和一个银制吹嘴。

entries.en: The envelope contained an empty Mogadon carton, folded flat.
entries.zh: 信封里装着一个折平了的Mogadon空药盒。

entries.en: Katerina chose the plain ribbon because the patterned one distracted from the flowers.
entries.zh: 卡捷琳娜选了素色缎带，因为带花纹的那条会抢了鲜花的风头。

entries.en: Joubert kept the receipt, although the shopkeeper said it would not be needed.
entries.zh: 店主说不需要收据，茹贝尔还是把它留了下来。

entries.en: Jaffe was still searching for the matching glove when the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车到达时，贾菲还在找配对的另一只手套。

entries.en: Hiram set the alarm early enough to watch the dough rise before work.
entries.zh: 海勒姆把闹钟定得很早，好在上班前看着面团发起来。

entries.en: Hamley left a note explaining why the garden gate had been tied shut.
entries.zh: 哈姆利留了张字条，解释花园门为什么被绑住了。

entries.en: Hadden reached for the salt, then remembered that he had already added some.
entries.zh: 哈登伸手去拿盐，随后想起自己已经放过了。

entries.en: Gottlieb wrapped the cracked bowl in newspaper rather than throw it away.
entries.zh: 戈特利布没有扔掉那只裂碗，而是用报纸把它包了起来。

entries.en: A bottle of Glenfiddich arrived in a box much larger than I expected.
entries.zh: 一瓶格兰菲迪酒送到了，箱子比我预想的大得多。

entries.en: Ennis paused at the doorway, unsure whether the argument was over.
entries.zh: 恩尼斯在门口停了下来，不确定争吵是否已经结束。

entries.en: Eggleston remembered the tune but could not find the first note on the piano.
entries.zh: 埃格尔斯顿记得那段曲调，却在钢琴上找不到第一个音。

entries.en: Dunkley covered the unfinished puzzle with a cloth before the guests arrived.
entries.zh: 客人到来前，邓克利用一块布盖住了没拼完的拼图。

entries.en: We had planned to leave Duisburg that morning, but our luggage was still missing.
entries.zh: 我们原计划那天早上离开杜伊斯堡，但行李仍然没找到。

entries.en: Demetrio preferred the uneven handmade cup to the perfect ones in the shop.
entries.zh: 比起店里那些完美的杯子，德梅特里奥更喜欢那只不太规整的手工杯。

entries.en: The letter from Cargill had arrived at the wrong office.
entries.zh: 那封嘉吉公司的来信送错了办公室。

entries.en: Bysshe could hear the rain through the open window but could not see outside.
entries.zh: 比希能从开着的窗户听见雨声，却看不到外面。

entries.en: Blatch moved the chair closer so that everyone could reach the game board.
entries.zh: 布拉奇把椅子挪近了一点，好让每个人都够得着棋盘。

entries.en: Two Bangladeshis in our class offered to translate the recorded interview.
entries.zh: 我们班上两位孟加拉国人提出为录下的采访做翻译。

entries.en: Baez had brought a camera, but the memory card was still at home.
entries.zh: 巴埃斯带了相机，存储卡却还在家里。

entries.en: The illustrator drew Atalanta in the margin, then erased the whole sketch.
entries.zh: 插画师在页边画了阿塔兰特，随后又把整幅草图擦掉了。

entries.en: Anjelica could not remember which pocket held the spare ticket.
entries.zh: 安杰丽卡想不起备用票放在哪个口袋里了。

entries.en: The rain caught us just as we were leaving Angeli.
entries.zh: 我们离开昂厄利时，正赶上下雨。

entries.en: Alois promised to return the ladder before anyone needed to clean the windows.
entries.zh: 阿洛伊斯答应，在有人需要擦窗之前把梯子还回来。

entries.en: Zinoviev read the invitation twice before noticing that the date had changed.
entries.zh: 季诺维也夫把邀请函读了两遍，才注意到日期改了。

entries.en: An old SIME catalogue had been used to level the wobbly desk.
entries.zh: 一份西美公司的旧产品目录被拿来垫平那张摇晃的桌子。

entries.en: Panton asked for a smaller plate, leaving the larger one for the cake.
entries.zh: 潘顿要了一个小一些的盘子，把大盘子留给蛋糕。

entries.en: Jodrell drew the curtains, hoping the room would stay cool until evening.
entries.zh: 乔德雷尔拉上窗帘，希望房间能一直凉快到傍晚。

entries.en: My father's sister left her reading glasses at the house we rented in Horwich.
entries.zh: 我姑妈把老花镜落在了我们在霍里奇租的房子里。

entries.en: Hindle bent the photograph slightly to fit it into the damaged frame.
entries.zh: 欣德尔把照片稍稍弯了一下，好把它放进那个破损的相框里。

entries.en: Hillyard blamed the loose floorboard, not the dog, for the sudden noise.
entries.zh: 希利亚德认为突如其来的响声是松动的地板造成的，不是狗弄出来的。

entries.en: Harrop kept his muddy boots outside even after the rain had stopped.
entries.zh: 即使雨停了，哈罗普还是把沾满泥的靴子放在外面。

entries.en: Hannan had already finished cutting the fabric when she discovered the error in her measurements.
entries.zh: 汉南发现尺寸量错时，已经把布裁好了。

entries.en: Giordano offered to carry the groceries while I searched for my keys.
entries.zh: 我找钥匙时，焦尔达诺提出帮我提着买来的东西。

entries.en: Gigli waited for the glue to dry before testing the repaired handle.
entries.zh: 吉利等胶水干了，才试了试修好的把手。

entries.en: Follett hid the birthday cake behind a stack of empty biscuit tins.
entries.zh: 福利特把生日蛋糕藏在了一摞空饼干罐后面。

entries.en: Elson would lend us the tent if we promised to bring it back dry.
entries.zh: 只要我们答应还回来时帐篷是干的，埃尔森就肯把它借给我们。

entries.en: Buffon tied a red thread around the key so that it would be easier to find.
entries.zh: 布冯在钥匙上系了一根红线，好让它更容易找到。

entries.en: The postcard from Zermatt reached us a week after its sender came home.
entries.zh: 那张来自策马特的明信片，在寄信人回家一周后才送到我们手中。

entries.en: Whitefield stopped sweeping the floor when a wedding ring rolled out from under the cupboard.
entries.zh: 一枚结婚戒指从橱柜底下滚出来时，怀特菲尔德停下了扫地的动作。

entries.en: Tubbs had packed the chess pieces but left the board on the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 塔布斯把棋子装好了，却把棋盘留在了厨房桌上。

entries.en: Her work in biodynamics grew out of a fascination with how beetles move.
entries.zh: 她的生物动力学研究源自对甲虫如何运动的着迷。

entries.en: Strutt suggested turning the rug around to hide the faded patch.
entries.zh: 斯特拉特建议把地毯调个方向，以遮住那块褪色的地方。

entries.en: Phillimore placed the last clean cup beside the kettle and went to wash the others.
entries.zh: 菲利莫尔把最后一只干净杯子放在水壶旁，便去洗其他杯子了。

entries.en: Marjory recognized the shop from a photograph her older brother had mailed her years earlier.
entries.zh: 玛乔丽凭哥哥多年前寄来的一张照片认出了那家店。

entries.en: Katrin had sewn a tiny pocket inside the coat for her spare key.
entries.zh: 卡特琳在外套里面缝了一个小口袋，用来放备用钥匙。

entries.en: Gasset reached the platform just in time to wave through the train window.
entries.zh: 加塞特及时赶到站台，朝火车车窗里挥了挥手。

entries.en: Duddon put the parcel on the floor because the table was covered with wet paint.
entries.zh: 桌面上都是未干的油漆，所以达登把包裹放到了地上。

entries.en: She still kept the postcards her father mailed while he had histoplasmosis.
entries.zh: 她仍然留着父亲患组织胞浆菌病期间寄来的明信片。

entries.en: Cristo took the stairs two at a time when he heard the telephone ringing.
entries.zh: 克里斯多听见电话响，走楼梯时便每步跨两级台阶。

entries.en: The old invoice from Ciba had been folded around a pressed leaf.
entries.zh: 那张汽巴公司的旧发票折起来，包着一片压干的叶子。

entries.en: Chesters had written the shopping list on the back of an unfinished crossword.
entries.zh: 切斯特斯把购物清单写在了一张还没做完的填字游戏背面。

entries.en: Calthorpe brought a cushion for the chair that nobody else wanted to use.
entries.zh: 考尔索普给那把别人都不想坐的椅子带来了一个坐垫。

entries.en: Callander listened at the door before deciding whether to knock.
entries.zh: 卡兰德在门口听了听，才决定要不要敲门。

entries.en: Birley opened the drawer slowly to avoid waking the cat asleep beneath it.
entries.zh: 伯利慢慢拉开抽屉，免得吵醒睡在抽屉下面的猫。

entries.en: Bewley had left room in the suitcase for the books we meant to bring home.
entries.zh: 比利在行李箱里留了空间，放我们打算带回家的书。

entries.en: Appian checked the pockets of the old coat before giving it away.
entries.zh: 阿皮安把旧外套送人之前，检查了一遍衣服口袋。

entries.en: Behan knocked over the empty vase while reaching for a book behind it.
entries.zh: 贝汉伸手拿花瓶后面的书时，碰倒了那只空花瓶。

entries.en: Bayne wanted the photograph left crooked because it reminded him of home.
entries.zh: 贝恩希望照片就那样歪着，因为这让他想起了家。

entries.en: The group's relaxed netiquette did not excuse sharing another member's private messages.
entries.zh: 群里的网络礼仪虽不拘谨，也不意味着可以分享别的成员的私信。

entries.en: Barrell kept the old lampshade because its colour matched the curtains so well.
entries.zh: 巴雷尔留着那个旧灯罩，因为它的颜色与窗帘很相配。

entries.en: An acker broke the reflection as the old boatman leaned over the side.
entries.zh: 老船夫探身到船舷外时，一道波纹搅乱了倒影。

entries.meaningZh: 马穆鲁克骑兵〔历史称谓〕
entries.en: In the novel, a Mamluk refuses to surrender the keys to the city gates.
entries.zh: 在那部小说里，一名马穆鲁克骑兵拒绝交出城门钥匙。

entries.en: The chemist could not account for the missing bottle of hydroquinone.
entries.zh: 化学家解释不了那瓶对苯二酚为什么不见了。

entries.en: Her battered copy of Villette no longer closed properly.
entries.zh: 她那本破旧的《维莱特》已经合不拢了。

entries.en: The repair shop still had three VCRs waiting for parts.
entries.zh: 那家维修店还有三台录像机在等零件。

entries.en: Swanton had left the umbrella open in the hallway to let it dry.
entries.zh: 斯旺顿把伞撑开放在走廊里晾干。

entries.en: She unfolded the old map of the Sudetenland on the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 她在厨房桌上展开了那张苏台德区的旧地图。

entries.en: Picard tapped the empty pocket and realized that the tickets were in his other coat.
entries.zh: 皮卡尔拍了拍空口袋，才意识到票在另一件外套里。

entries.en: Pasmore had promised to mend the fence, but the borrowed tools never arrived.
entries.zh: 帕斯莫尔答应修篱笆，但借的工具始终没送到。

entries.en: Papin kept laughing while everyone else tried to remember how the joke had begun.
entries.zh: 别人都在努力回想那个笑话是怎么开头的，帕潘却一直笑个不停。

entries.en: Otello chose the heavier blanket despite the warning that the room would be warm.
entries.zh: 尽管有人提醒房间会很暖和，奥泰洛还是选了那条更重的毯子。

entries.en: Moreno turned the postcard over, hoping to find an address beneath the faded message.
entries.zh: 莫雷诺把明信片翻过来，希望在褪色的留言下面找到地址。

entries.en: Mathieson had not expected the kitten to fall asleep inside his open suitcase.
entries.zh: 马西森没想到小猫会在他敞开的行李箱里睡着。

entries.en: Marietta brought enough thread to finish the repair but had forgotten to bring the needle.
entries.zh: 玛丽埃塔带的线足够把东西缝补好，却忘了带针。

entries.en: Leclerc used the corner of a postcard to mark his place in the novel.
entries.zh: 勒克莱尔用明信片的一角标记小说读到的位置。

entries.en: Knopf asked us to leave the garden untouched until his daughter had taken a photograph.
entries.zh: 克诺夫请我们先别动花园里的东西，等女儿拍完照片再说。

entries.en: Jonsson spread the damp photographs across the only dry table in the room.
entries.zh: 琼森把受潮的照片摊在房间里唯一干燥的桌子上。

entries.en: Isidore could not reach the shelf without moving the sleeping dog.
entries.zh: 伊西多尔若不挪开那只睡着的狗，就够不着架子。

entries.en: Ibbotson found the missing button caught in the lining of the coat.
entries.zh: 伊博森发现丢失的纽扣卡在了外套的衬里中。

entries.en: Hockley poured the tea, then noticed that one cup still contained a paintbrush.
entries.zh: 霍克利倒了茶，才注意到有个杯子里还放着一支画笔。

entries.en: Hannigan had already wrapped the present when the child changed her mind about the colour.
entries.zh: 汉尼根已经把礼物包好了，孩子却对颜色改变了主意。

entries.en: The two biographies of Vasco da Gama differed most in their opening chapters.
entries.zh: 那两部伽马传记差异最大的是开头几章。

entries.en: We watched Desiree with the subtitles on because the sound was too quiet.
entries.zh: 声音太小，所以我们看《拿破仑情史》时开着字幕。

entries.en: The photograph from Damme was the only one that survived the leaking roof.
entries.zh: 屋顶漏雨后，只有那张来自达默的照片保存了下来。

entries.en: Chalfont slipped the invitation under the door rather than disturb the piano lesson.
entries.zh: 查尔方特把邀请函从门下塞了进去，没有打扰钢琴课。

entries.en: Busch had brought the wrong glasses and could barely read the menu.
entries.zh: 布施带错了眼镜，几乎看不清菜单。

entries.en: Brendon offered me the window seat, then fell asleep before the train moved.
entries.zh: 布伦登提出把靠窗的座位让给我，随后火车还没开就睡着了。

entries.en: Bonzo had saved a piece of string exactly long enough to tie around the parcel.
entries.zh: 邦佐留着一根绳子，长度恰好够捆那个包裹。

entries.en: Beal recognized the umbrella by the tiny tear near its handle.
entries.zh: 比尔凭伞柄附近的小破口认出了那把伞。

entries.en: We left Bamberg with two suitcases and a cardboard box full of books.
entries.zh: 我们带着两个行李箱和一纸箱书离开了班贝克。

entries.en: Atwood had kept the broken watch because it still reminded him of his father.
entries.zh: 阿特伍德留着那块坏表，因为它仍能让他想起父亲。

entries.en: Adrien tried the door handle twice before realizing that he was pulling instead of pushing.
entries.zh: 阿德里安试了两次门把手，才意识到该推门，自己却一直在拉。

entries.en: His Latinization of the family name annoyed relatives who preferred the original spelling.
entries.zh: 他把家族姓氏拉丁语化，惹恼了那些喜欢原来拼法的亲属。

entries.en: The weaker thermoluminescence from the second crystal surprised the researchers.
entries.zh: 第二块晶体较弱的热致发光让研究人员感到意外。

entries.en: The medical illustrator redrew the eyelids without changing the degree of proptosis shown.
entries.zh: 医学插画师重画了眼睑，但没有改变图上表现的眼球突出程度。

entries.en: Velasquez had brought a map, but the rain had washed away his pencilled directions.
entries.zh: 委拉斯奎兹带了地图，但雨水把他用铅笔标的路线冲掉了。

entries.en: Stoute refused the new suitcase because the old one still closed perfectly well.
entries.zh: 斯托特不要那个新行李箱，因为旧的仍然能好好合上。

entries.en: Sargeant had brought the picnic basket but forgotten where we were supposed to meet.
entries.zh: 萨金特带了野餐篮，却忘了我们约在哪里见面。

entries.en: Ritter left the window open just wide enough for the cat to get through.
entries.zh: 里特尔把窗户开了一条缝，刚好够猫钻过去。

entries.en: Pryor folded the paper boat again, this time making the two sides match.
entries.zh: 普赖尔重新折了那只纸船，这次让两边对齐了。

entries.en: Penrhyn searched the empty drawer, unwilling to believe that the letters were gone.
entries.zh: 彭林在空抽屉里翻找，不愿相信那些信已经不见了。

entries.en: Maurizio chose a seat near the door in case he needed to leave quietly.
entries.zh: 毛里齐奥选了一个靠门的座位，以便需要时能悄悄离开。

entries.en: Maughan could hear someone practising the violin in the room above.
entries.zh: 莫恩能听见有人在楼上的房间里练小提琴。

entries.en: Landon rescued the torn wrapping paper because the child wanted to keep the pictures.
entries.zh: 孩子想留下上面的图案，所以兰德勒把撕破的包装纸收了起来。

entries.en: Hiscock counted the cups again when two unexpected visitors appeared at the gate.
entries.zh: 门口来了两位意外的访客，希斯科克又数了一遍杯子。

entries.en: Gwilym held up the cracked tile to see how the two pieces fitted together.
entries.zh: 格威利姆举起裂开的瓷砖，看两块碎片怎么拼在一起。

entries.en: The parcel from Granta was waiting behind the flowerpots when I got home.
entries.zh: 我到家时，来自格兰塔出版社的包裹正放在花盆后面等我。

entries.en: Girvan lent us a tablecloth, warning that the blue dye sometimes came off.
entries.zh: 格文借给我们一块桌布，提醒我们上面的蓝色有时会掉色。

entries.en: Geoghegan had hidden the spare biscuits in a tin nobody else could open.
entries.zh: 盖根把备用的饼干藏在一个别人都打不开的罐子里。

entries.en: Fromm could not find his slippers because the dog had carried them into the garden.
entries.zh: 弗罗姆找不到拖鞋，因为狗把它们叼到花园里去了。

entries.en: Cahn turned the music down to hear whether the kettle had begun to whistle.
entries.zh: 卡恩把音乐调小，想听听水壶是不是已经响了。

entries.en: Beasley had saved the empty picture frame for a photograph that never arrived.
entries.zh: 比斯利留着那个空相框，想放一张始终没有送到的照片。

entries.en: In the old farmhouse kitchen, the kettle rested on a brandreth beside the hearth.
entries.zh: 在那间旧农舍厨房里，水壶搁在炉边的铁三脚架上。

entries.en: Acland asked us not to fold the map along the damaged crease.
entries.zh: 阿克兰请我们不要沿着那道破损的折痕折地图。

entries.en: The artist copied a Pompeian wall painting, leaving out the damaged sections.
entries.zh: 画家临摹了一幅庞培壁画，略去了破损的部分。

entries.en: Her drawings of embryogenesis were ruined when water spilled across the notebook.
entries.zh: 水洒到笔记本上，毁了她画的胚胎发生过程图。

entries.en: We arrived in Wheaton with the wrong suitcase and no way to contact its owner.
entries.zh: 我们拿着别人的行李箱到了惠顿，却无法联系箱子的主人。

entries.en: Welton had taken down the curtains before noticing that rain was coming through the window.
entries.zh: 韦尔顿摘下窗帘后，才发现雨正从窗户飘进来。

entries.en: Vittoria wanted the cracked plate repaired, not replaced with a new one.
entries.zh: 维特多利亚想把那只裂盘子修好，不想换个新的。

entries.en: The old letter from Tyumen contained a photograph folded into four.
entries.zh: 那封来自秋明的旧信里夹着一张折成四层的照片。

entries.en: My parents argued about Travolta's performance long after the film had ended.
entries.zh: 电影结束很久以后，我父母还在争论特拉沃尔塔的表演。

entries.en: The lab assistant could not tell which phosphide was in the damaged container.
entries.zh: 实验室助理无法确定破损容器里的是哪种磷化物。

entries.en: Her father's photographs of Sakhalin were scattered across the desk beside the open suitcase.
entries.zh: 她父亲的那些库页岛照片散放在桌上，旁边是打开的行李箱。

entries.en: Prideaux had promised to leave the gate unlocked until everyone was back.
entries.zh: 普里多答应在所有人回来之前不锁大门。

entries.en: Our last afternoon in Poznan was spent searching for the notebook I had lost.
entries.zh: 在波兹南的最后一个下午，我们都在找我丢失的笔记本。

entries.en: Posner saved the smallest box for the ring that had belonged to his mother.
entries.zh: 波斯纳把最小的盒子留给了那枚原本属于他母亲的戒指。

entries.en: The family album contained several photographs of Lvov that nobody could date.
entries.zh: 家庭相册里有几张利沃夫的照片，谁也说不出是什么时候拍的。

entries.en: Gittings had already ordered dessert when the others remembered the cake at home.
entries.zh: 吉廷斯已经点了甜点，其他人才想起家里还有蛋糕。

entries.en: Georgiana pulled the chair closer to read the tiny writing on the postcard.
entries.zh: 乔治亚娜把椅子拉近了一点，好看清明信片上的小字。

entries.en: We stopped Elektra halfway through because the old television had lost its sound.
entries.zh: 旧电视没了声音，所以我们看《艾丽卡》看到一半就停了。

entries.en: Davids noticed that the borrowed bicycle had a different bell from his own.
entries.zh: 戴维斯注意到，借来的自行车车铃与自己那辆的不一样。

entries.en: Cupar left the jam jar open while looking for a clean spoon.
entries.zh: 楚帕尔找干净勺子时，没有盖上果酱罐。

entries.en: The envelope from Ashmore contained a letter addressed to the previous tenant.
entries.zh: 来自安石公司的那个信封里，装着一封写给前一位租户的信。

entries.en: She kept her old Alitalia ticket inside the guidebook she had taken on that trip.
entries.zh: 她把那张意大利航空公司的旧机票夹在那次旅行带的指南里。

entries.meaningZh: 古斯塔夫王统治时期的
entries.en: The historian examined a Gustavian letter whose final page was missing.
entries.zh: 历史学家查看了一封古斯塔夫王统治时期的信，信的最后一页不见了。

entries.en: Westley chose a cardboard box rather than risk scratching the borrowed suitcase.
entries.zh: 韦斯特利选了纸箱，不愿冒险刮伤借来的行李箱。

entries.en: Syed had almost finished the soup when he noticed the untouched bread.
entries.zh: 赛义德差不多喝完汤时，才注意到面包还没动。

entries.en: Shanahan took the longer route home to avoid carrying the parcel up the steep steps.
entries.zh: 沙纳汉绕远路回家，免得提着包裹爬那些陡峭的台阶。

entries.en: Ruiz stopped stirring the paint when the colour finally matched the old door.
entries.zh: 颜色终于与旧门相配时，鲁伊斯停止了搅拌油漆。

entries.en: Radice kept the lid, hoping that the missing tin would turn up eventually.
entries.zh: 雷迪斯留着罐盖，希望丢失的罐子最终能找到。

entries.en: Millington could not remember whether he had promised to bring chairs or plates.
entries.zh: 米林顿想不起自己答应带的是椅子还是盘子了。

entries.en: Howey had left the windows open, and rain had soaked the unfinished painting.
entries.zh: 豪伊没关窗户，雨水把那幅没画完的画浸湿了。

entries.en: Harmondsworth borrowed my scarf and wrapped it around the cracked handle of his suitcase.
entries.zh: 哈蒙兹沃思借了我的围巾，裹在行李箱开裂的把手上。

entries.en: Garnham asked for the old recipe book, not the clean copy without handwritten notes.
entries.zh: 加纳姆要那本旧食谱，不要那本没有手写笔记的干净版本。

entries.en: Delamere returned the empty basket with a note thanking us for the apples.
entries.zh: 德拉米尔归还空篮子时，附了张字条感谢我们送的苹果。

entries.meaningZh: 英国圣公会圣职者名册〔书名〕
entries.en: She consulted Crockford's Clerical Directory before replying to the unfamiliar correspondent.
entries.zh: 她查阅了英国圣公会圣职者名册，才给那位不熟悉的来信人回信。

entries.en: The old map showed the Bolan Pass, but its margins had been eaten by insects.
entries.zh: 那张旧地图上画有波伦山口，但边缘已经被虫蛀了。

entries.en: The new extruder would not fit through the workshop doorway until the doorframe was removed.
entries.zh: 不拆下车间门框，那台新挤出机就进不了门。

entries.en: Thorney left the last biscuit untouched so that the child could have it later.
entries.zh: 索尼没有吃最后一块饼干，好留给孩子待会儿吃。

entries.en: Sherwin had closed the curtains before remembering that the plants needed watering.
entries.zh: 舍温拉上窗帘后，才想起那些植物还需要浇水。

entries.en: Sedley folded the blanket over the chair to hide the torn upholstery on the seat.
entries.zh: 塞德利把毯子折着搭在椅子上，遮住破损的椅面。

entries.en: I lent her my Santana records and forgot to ask for them back.
entries.zh: 我把自己的桑塔纳乐队唱片借给了她，后来忘了要回来。

entries.en: Purnell had cut the string too short to tie around the parcel.
entries.zh: 珀内尔把绳子剪得太短，捆不了那个包裹。

entries.en: Millicent had made room on the shelf for the books she hoped to borrow.
entries.zh: 米利森特在书架上腾出了位置，放自己想借的那些书。

entries.en: Mehta pushed the suitcase under the bed and discovered a second pair of slippers.
entries.zh: 梅塔把行李箱推到床底下时，发现了第二双拖鞋。

entries.en: McCaffrey preferred the handwritten invitation, even though the printed one was easier to read.
entries.zh: 尽管印刷版更容易看清，麦卡弗里还是更喜欢那张手写的邀请函。

entries.en: She chose Killarney for the shutters but left the door white.
entries.zh: 她给百叶窗选了基拉尼绿，却让门保持白色。

entries.en: Hynes carried the clock flat on his lap to protect its loose glass cover.
entries.zh: 海因斯把钟平放在膝上，保护那块松动的玻璃罩。

entries.en: Hopkin had saved the torn envelope because the address was the only clue he had.
entries.zh: 霍普金留着那个破信封，因为上面的地址是他仅有的线索。

entries.en: Gabriella put the empty vase on the windowsill to see how it caught the light.
entries.zh: 加布里埃尔把空花瓶放在窗台上，看光线照在上面是什么效果。

entries.en: Friel had packed the paintbrushes before remembering the door he had not finished painting.
entries.zh: 弗里尔收好画笔后，才想起那扇门还没刷完。

entries.en: Deighton could not close the cupboard because a saucepan handle was caught behind the door.
entries.zh: 戴顿关不上橱柜，因为一只长柄锅的把手卡在柜门后面了。

entries.en: Blount held the torch while we searched for the screw beneath the sink.
entries.zh: 我们在水槽下找螺丝时，布朗特拿着手电筒照亮。

entries.en: Bianco had brought a folding chair, expecting the meeting to last all afternoon.
entries.zh: 比安科带了把折叠椅，预料会议会持续整个下午。

entries.meaningZh: 多因素决定〔精神分析中的梦境解释〕
entries.en: They disagreed about the overdetermination of the dream, not about what the dreamer remembered.
entries.zh: 他们对这个梦的多因素决定有不同看法，而对做梦者记得的内容没有分歧。

entries.en: A gutta of the dark mixture stained the apothecary's clean cuff.
entries.zh: 一滴深色混合液弄脏了药剂师干净的袖口。

entries.en: A fragment of coquina fell from the crumbling edge of the old wall.
entries.zh: 一块贝壳灰岩从旧墙破碎的边缘掉了下来。

entries.en: My scarf caught on the ceanothus beside the gate.
entries.zh: 我的围巾挂在了门边的美洲茶上。

entries.en: Savary had promised to keep the box unopened until the family was together.
entries.zh: 萨瓦里答应等家人聚齐后再打开那个盒子。

entries.en: Naish had already washed the cups when we discovered the untouched pot of tea.
entries.zh: 我们发现那壶茶还没动时，奈什已经把杯子洗好了。
